trainers.instruction: Decide if friction would be useful in this situation or not.

atoms.a: friction between the soles of shoes and a log
Why would friction be useful in this situation?
b: It makes it easier to slip over.
++It stops you from slipping as much.

instruction.text: Decide if friction would be useful in this situation or not.

atoms.a: friction between you and a slide
Why would friction not be useful in this situation?
b: It would make you slide too fast.
It would make the slide less steep.

instruction.text: Decide if friction would be useful in this situation or not.

atoms.a: friction between your bike wheel and its brake
Why would friction be useful in this situation?
b: It will stop you from being able to brake.
It will make the bike too slow.

trainers.instruction: Decide if each action will increase or decrease friction.

atoms.b: spreading grit salt over an icy road
